messages:
deploy-bot: kicking off change window for v2.4.1 canary -> 10% eu-west. preflight checks running. pinging ops for SLO watch. @maria @sam
monitoring-bot: preflight check: collecting last-5m SLOs (latency, errors, ingestion). ETA ~30s.
maria: on it, watching dashboards. will flag anything abnormal.
sam: tip: keep an eye on downstream auth 502s — saw a blip earlier.
monitoring-bot: ALERT: sentry-ingest-lag.euw > 30s (1m avg) - count: 42
monitoring-bot: metrics snapshot:
```
metric: sentry.ingest.lag_seconds
1m_avg: 34.2
p95_latency_ms: 620
errors_5m: 0.8%
```
kevin: hmm, that's higher than baseline but errors still <1%. can we wait 2 more minutes to see trend?
alexa: agree with kevin. if lag regresses to >45s or errors >2% we should pause.
maria: checking trace queues, looks like a retention GC is running on the ingest cluster — infra aware? @kevin
kevin: infra says a rolling index compaction started 90s ago in eu-west. shouldn't impact routing but may increase I/O. they said it'll finish in ~120s.
sam: given that, i'd hold the canary for now. no need to push while index compaction in-flight.
deploy-bot: action: pause traffic shift -> canary hold. noted reason: sentry ingest lag spike during index compaction.
maria: adding note to release notes: "Hold at 10% canary due to transient sentry ingestion lag; monitoring ongoing."
monitoring-bot: continuing sampling every 30s. next snapshot in 28s.
monitoring-bot: snapshot: 1m_avg 28.9s, p95 490ms, errors 0.6% (trend down)
kevin: compaction finished, infra confirms. trend looks recovering.
sam: ok, re-run smoke checks for auth and embeddings routes, then we can resume shift if clean.
maria: running smoke: `/scripts/smoke-checks --routes auth,embed --region eu-west --count 25`
maria: smoke results: auth 25/25 OK, embed 25/25 OK, avg latency within baseline.
alexa: recommend resume with slow ramp: +10% every 5m. if any metric crosses thresholds rollback immediately.
kevin: agree. set automation: if errors >1.5% OR p95 > 800ms -> auto-pause and notify oncall.
sam: I've updated the deploy playbook with those thresholds and pinned the canary to v2.4.1-rc3 for traceability.
deploy-bot: resuming traffic shift: +10% now -> 20%. scheduled increments every 5m. watch SLOs closely.
maria: watching dashboards. will call if anything odd. :eyes:
monitoring-bot: note: rolling alert suppression for the compaction window has ended. normal alerting active.
alexa: small note for postmortem: include index compaction timing and whether we can schedule compactions outside change windows.
kevin: logged follow-up ticket: INF-1921 "avoid heavy compaction during change windows"
sam: thanks team. keeping an eye. :thumbsup:
monitoring-bot: final snapshot (after resume): 1m_avg 22.1s, p95 360ms, errors 0.4%
maria: marking this thread resolved for the change window. will add blurb to release notes and rollout timeline.
